title: 第三章 接受挑战第四章 以凡战修
content_zh:
风凌的狂言让姜万里的眉头微微皱起，显然也有点搞不清楚，为什么对方突然之间就不怕柳天仁了。
不等姜万里开口，站在他身旁的姜穆已经抢着道：“姜叔，和他们废什么话，我倒要看看，他们准备怎么血洗我们姜家村！”
“就是，老村长，难道我们还怕了不成！”
“云娃子是我们村子的人，谁敢动他，先过了我这关！”
姜穆的话顿时引起了四周姜村众人的附和，一个个都是摩拳擦掌，咬牙切齿的准备和风村大战一场。
提到战斗，对于生活在十万莽山中的人来说，没有一个陌生的，因为他们要想在这里生存，就必须要常年和各种凶兽搏斗。
这点从姜云那遍布身体的伤痕就不难看出，十六岁的他，毫不夸张的说，已经是身经百战，甚至有数次更是和死亡擦肩而过，所以，莽山的人，从不畏战。
面对群情激奋的姜村人，风村众人自然也是不甘示弱，气势汹汹的吼道：“战就战，今天势必要让你们姜村血流成河！”
“那些娘们可别动，早就听说姜村的女子别有一番韵味，嘿嘿，这次正好带几个回去享受享受！”
眼看两村众人之间已经是剑拔弩张，一场大战一触即发，但是一声大喝突然响起，打断了所有人的声音：“住口！”
众人循声看去，发现说话的赫然就是刚刚挤到人群前方的姜云。
此刻的姜云，面色铁青，双眼之中露出了一抹凶光。
就如同姜村的人将他当成了亲人一样，他也早就将他们当成了亲人，将这里当成了家，所以他不能忍受风村人对于自己家人的污言秽语。
更何况，这一切都是因他而起。
十岁之前的姜云年纪还小，那时的他只能躲在爷爷的身后，依靠爷爷的保护，可是现在的他，已经十六岁，按照莽山的规矩，他即将成年。
看到姜云终于出现，风凌的眼睛顿时一亮，刚想开口，但是空中却是陡然传来了一道尖锐的破空之声。
“咻！”
一道劲风凝聚成利刃，凭空出现，毫无预兆的直接向着姜云射了过来，速度快到了极致。
术法！
虽然此刻是被人偷袭，但是看到这道风刃，姜云的心中仍然不可避免的生出了一丝羡慕，因为这是修士才能施展的手段。

“不过，这术法，也伤不了我！”
姜云眼中寒光一闪，刚想出手，一旁的姜穆却是抢先一步，狠狠一拳砸在了那道风刃之上。
“砰！”
风刃瞬间炸开，消散在了空中，而姜穆面罩寒霜的收回了手掌，目光看向了风凌身后站立着的一个面色阴鸷的青年人，冷冷的道：“风无忌，你好歹也是迈入了通脉五重的成年修士，竟然偷袭一个不能修炼的孩子，你风村，莫非都是这么不要脸吗？”
姜云虽然不能修炼，但是却也知道修炼的前三个境界，从低到高分别是通脉境，福地境和洞天境，每个境界又分九重。
看上去通脉境虽然只是入门之境，但是一旦迈入，就等于踏上了修道之路，不容小觑，尤其是姜云更知道，姜村之中，三十岁以下的，到目前为止最高也不过才修炼到了通脉四重。
而眼前这个被称作风无忌的青年，不过十八九岁的年纪，却已经是通脉五重之境，不得不说是个修炼天才。
可越是如此，以他的身份和修为竟然还要偷袭姜云，这种行为也越是让人不耻。
一双斜飞入鬓的丹凤眼，让风无忌的长相透出几分阴柔，而此刻非但没有觉得自己有什么不对，脸中反而是露出一抹讥讽之色道：“你在打猎的时候，莫非出手之前，还会和猎物打个招呼不成？”
“你！”
content_en:
Feng Ling's arrogance made Jiang Wanli frown slightly, and he was obviously a little confused as to why the other party was suddenly no longer afraid of Liu Tianren.
Before Jiang Wanli could speak, Jiang Mu, who was standing next to him, had already rushed to say: "Uncle Jiang, what nonsense are you talking to them about? I want to see how they plan to bloodbath our Jiangjia Village!"
"That's right, old village chief, are we still afraid?"
"Yunwazi is from our village. Anyone who dares to touch him must get through me first!"
Jiang Mu's words immediately aroused the echo of everyone in the surrounding Jiang Village. Everyone was gearing up and gritting their teeth to prepare for a battle with Feng Village.
When it comes to fighting, no one who lives in Shiwanmang Mountain is unfamiliar, because if they want to survive here, they must fight against various ferocious beasts all year round.
It is not difficult to see this from the scars all over Jiang Yun's body. At the age of sixteen, it is no exaggeration to say that he has experienced hundreds of battles and even passed death several times. Therefore, the people of Mangshan are never afraid of fighting.
Facing the excited Jiangcun people, the people in Fengcun were naturally not to be outdone, and roared aggressively: "Fight, fight, today your Jiangcun will be bleeding like a river!"
"Those ladies, don't move. I've long heard that the women in Jiang Village have a special charm. Hehe, I just brought a few back this time to enjoy them!"
Seeing that the tension between the two villages was already tense, a war was about to break out, but a loud shout suddenly sounded, interrupting everyone: "Shut up!"
Everyone followed the sound and found that the speaker was Jiang Yun, who had just squeezed into the front of the crowd.
At this moment, Jiang Yun's face was ashen, and there was a fierce light in his eyes.
Just as the people in Jiang Village regarded him as a relative, he had long regarded them as relatives and regarded this place as his home, so he could not bear the filthy words spoken by the people in Feng Village towards his family.
What's more, all of this happened because of him.
Jiang Yun was still young before he was ten years old. At that time, he could only hide behind his grandfather and rely on his grandfather's protection. But now he is sixteen years old. According to Mangshan's rules, he is about to reach adulthood.
Seeing Jiang Yun finally appear, Feng Ling's eyes suddenly lit up, and he was about to speak, but a sharp sound of breaking through the air suddenly came from the air.
"Phew!"
A strong wind condensed into a sharp blade, appeared out of thin air, and shot directly towards Jiang Yun without any warning, at extremely fast speed.
Magic!
Although he was being attacked by someone at this moment, Jiang Yun still inevitably felt a trace of envy when he saw this wind blade, because this was a method that only monks could use.
"However, this technique can't hurt me!"
A cold light flashed in Jiang Yun's eyes, and just when he was about to take action, Jiang Mu on the side took the first step and punched the wind blade hard.
"Bang!"
The wind blade instantly exploded and dissipated in the air, and Jiang Mu retracted his palm with a frosty mask, looking at a young man with a sinister expression standing behind Feng Ling, and said coldly: "Feng Wuji, you have finally entered the fifth level of Tongmai as an adult monk, and you unexpectedly attacked a child who cannot practice. Are you, Fengcun, so shameless?"
Although Jiang Yun cannot practice, he also knows that the first three realms of cultivation, from low to high, are Tongmai Realm, Blessed Land Realm and Cave Heaven Realm, and each realm is divided into nine levels.
It seems that although Tongmai Realm is just an entry-level realm, once you enter it, it is equivalent to embarking on the path of cultivation, which should not be underestimated. Especially Jiang Yun knows that among Jiang Village, those under the age of thirty have only reached the fourth level of Tongmai Realm so far.
The young man in front of him, known as Feng Wuji, was only eighteen or nineteen years old, but he was already at the fifth level of Tongmai. He had to be said to be a cultivation genius.
But the more this happened, the more shameful this behavior was for him to attack Jiang Yun with his identity and cultivation level.
A pair of flyingThe piercing red phoenix eyes on the temples made Feng Wuji's appearance reveal a bit of femininity. At this moment, instead of feeling that there was anything wrong with him, a sarcastic look appeared on his face and he said: "When you are hunting, don't you say hello to your prey before taking action?"
"You!"
